hyperedges.label: Permission enforcement across backend and frontend

nodes.label: Backend: Spring Boot 4.1 / Java 25 / Spring Security 7 / JPA
nodes.norm_label: backend: spring boot 4.1 / java 25 / spring security 7 / jpa

nodes.label: Frontend: Vite + React 19 + TS + shadcn/ui (Base UI) + Tailwind 4
nodes.norm_label: frontend: vite + react 19 + ts + shadcn/ui (base ui) + tailwind 4

nodes.label: PrincipalRefreshFilter (session_version)
nodes.rationale: Reloads user from DB each request so role changes apply immediately; lock or password change invalidates old sessions.

nodes.label: Flyway migrations (ddl-auto=validate)
nodes.rationale: Schema is changed only through migrations; Hibernate only validates.

nodes.label: HTTP session + SPA CSRF authentication
nodes.rationale: No JWT and no CORS because frontend and API share one origin; JSESSIONID HttpOnly + XSRF-TOKEN header.

nodes.label: TanStack Query for server state (useMe)
nodes.rationale: All API data lives in TanStack Query; server data is never copied into Redux.

nodes.label: React Compiler (not enabled)
nodes.rationale: Disabled due to impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: Właściciel (system owner role)
nodes.rationale: Owner has all permissions, cannot be edited/deleted, at least one active owner must remain.

nodes.label: PermissionCategory (VIEW/EDIT per tool category)
nodes.rationale: Constant names are stored in DB, so existing ones must not be renamed.

nodes.label: Favicon (Vite lightning bolt logo)
nodes.rationale: Default Vite scaffold favicon: purple (#863bff) lightning-bolt shape masked over blurred purple/lavender/cyan gradient ellipses; not yet replaced with Intermarche branding.
